name: Hippolyta
subtitle: Amazonian Queen
description: Lead your allies to victory whilst defending them against incoming damage.
lore: The Amazon queen remains faithful to Olympus as a Realm and a pantheon, but her more specific loyalties are being tested. She holds fierce resentment toward Hercules for his actions in the old world. That he has ascended to godhood is infuriating, and that Zeus supported him has caused Hippolyta to question her fealty to the king of the gods as well…
